title: Save and restore a value
summary: Assembly: Save and restore a value. Push 4 instead.
introduction: push places a value on the stack. pop takes the most recent value back.
learningObjectives: Save and restore a value with Assembly

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Save and restore a value
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    push 7
    pop rdi
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: push stores 7 on the stack. pop places that most recent value in rdi.
